verdict.rationale: Headless or CI-driven automation is a fair axis for a SaaS equity and fund platform, since such products can ship APIs or CLIs. The evidence documents only UI-driven workflows plus vendor-managed HRIS integrations, which are an adjacent feature rather than user-run headless automation. The OpenAPI probe found no API spec at any candidate path, so there is no evidence of an API, CLI, or CI-runnable interface.
